title: Learn
description: Objective-based learning blocks for number systems, binary logic, and media representation.
notes: Learn blocks are completed when each Try It task is submitted and meets the mark threshold.
questionPrompt: Complete all Try It tasks to finish this Learn section.

blocks.text: In Paper 1, you must confidently convert between binary, denary, and hexadecimal.

items: Binary uses base 2 with place values 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, ...
Hexadecimal uses base 16 with digits 0-9 and A-F

slides.title: Number Systems and Place Value: Key terms

blocks.label: Exam Tip
blocks.text: Show each conversion step clearly to secure method marks.

slides.title: Binary to Denary Worked Example
slides.explanation: Add only the place values where the bit is 1.

slides.title: Try It: Number Conversion
slides.task: Convert 11001101₂ to denary and hexadecimal. Show each stage.

blocks.text: Binary addition and bit shifts are common in theory and short-answer questions.

slides.title: Binary Arithmetic and Shifts: Key terms

blocks.label: Shift Rule
blocks.text: A left shift by 1 multiplies by 2. A right shift by 1 divides by 2 (integer values).

slides.title: Binary Addition Example
slides.explanation: Carry across each column where 1 + 1 occurs.

blocks.text: You should explain file size and quality using technical terms like resolution, colour depth, sampling rate, and bit depth.

items: Higher image resolution increases detail and file size
Higher colour depth increases colour range and file size
Higher sampling rate and bit depth improve sound quality but increase storage

slides.title: Audio Size Relationship
slides.problem: How do we estimate uncompressed audio file size?
slides.explanation: This relation helps compare quality choices against storage cost.

slides.title: Try It: Explain Quality vs Storage
slides.task: Explain how increasing (a) image resolution and (b) audio bit depth affects quality and file size.
slides.expectedAnswer: Higher resolution and higher bit depth both improve quality and increase file size.
